options.content:
## Kiro Session → Delivery Trace
Traces AI sessions to delivery through commit-message trailers: **session → commit → merged PR → issue**.

- Data source: the `extractKiroSessionCommits` subtask (enabled by default in the kiro plugin) parses `Kiro-Session-Id` / `Devdelta-Session-Id` trailers out of commit messages already collected into the lake.
- **This is an AS-IS association**: no author verification and no trust gating. DevDelta's three-edge attribution (author match + trailer + SHA in merged PR) is the audited version; treat these numbers as descriptive lineage, not verified attribution.
- PR→issue edges come from `pull_request_issues`, which depends on teams referencing issue keys in PR titles/descriptions/branch names — missing links usually mean a missing convention, not missing AI work.
- **Per person** row: one series per *person* in every band, on one shared time axis, so a week can be read top-to-bottom: credits spent → AI-linked commits → PRs merged → issues resolved. People come from DevLake's **curated identity mapping** (`users` / `user_accounts`, i.e. the org plugin's users.csv and user_accounts.csv) — never from a heuristic. Pick people in the **Person** selector; each band is grouped bars on the same zero-filled week axis, so a person keeps one slot and one colour in every band. Accounts nobody has mapped do not appear there.
- **Scale**: the view is organised org → team → person. **By team** bands are the org-level read (a team is one bar, however many people it has). **Per person** bands are meant for a team-sized selection (≤ 8 people): pick a team first, then people. For many people use the **person × week matrix** (one row per person, colour = the metric chosen in the Metric selector; switching the metric keeps the row order). There is deliberately no ranking view.
- The collapsed **By raw identity** row keeps the four unmapped namespaces — Kiro users, PR authors (forge logins), issue assignees, git author emails — side by side and deliberately NOT merged: the only merge on this dashboard is the curated mapping above.

panels.title: Session-linked commits
panels.description: Distinct commits carrying a session trailer, authored in range

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sc.commit_sha) AS value FROM _tool_kiro_session_commits sc JOIN commits c ON c.sha = sc.commit_sha JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha WHERE $__timeFilter(c.authored_date) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project))

panels.title: Sessions reaching a commit
panels.description: Distinct session ids named by any commit in range

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sc.session_id) AS value FROM _tool_kiro_session_commits sc JOIN commits c ON c.sha = sc.commit_sha JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha WHERE $__timeFilter(c.authored_date) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project))

panels.title: Merged PRs touched
panels.description: Merged PRs containing at least one session-linked commit

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS value FROM _tool_kiro_session_commits sc JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha WHERE pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project))

panels.title: Issues reached
panels.description: Issues linked (via pull_request_issues) to a session-touched merged PR

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pri.issue_id) AS value FROM _tool_kiro_session_commits sc JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id JOIN pull_request_issues pri ON pri.pull_request_id = pr.id JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha WHERE pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project))

panels.title: By team: credits → AI-linked commits → merged PRs → resolved issues (org level; a team is one bar)
Team totals (selected range)
panels.description: Totals per team over the dashboard range. People = mapped members (team_users).

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.name AS `Team`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_users tu2 WHERE tu2.team_id = t.id) AS `People`, (SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.credits_used), 0)) FROM _tool_kiro_user_report r JOIN user_accounts ua ON ua.account_id = r.user_email WHERE ua.user_id IN (SELECT tu.user_id FROM team_users tu WHERE tu.team_id = t.id) AND $__timeFilter(r.date)) AS `Credits`, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sc.commit_sha) FROM _tool_kiro_session_commits sc JOIN commits c ON c.sha = sc.commit_sha JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha JOIN user_accounts ua ON ua.account_id = c.author_id WHERE ua.user_id IN (SELECT tu.user_id FROM team_users tu WHERE tu.team_id = t.id) AND $__timeFilter(c.authored_date) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project))) AS `AI-linked commits`, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) FROM pull_requests pr JOIN user_accounts ua ON ua.account_id = pr.author_id WHERE ua.user_id IN (SELECT tu.user_id FROM team_users tu WHERE tu.team_id = t.id) AND pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project))) AS `Merged PRs`, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) FROM issues i JOIN user_accounts ua ON ua.account_id = i.assignee_id WHERE ua.user_id IN (SELECT tu.user_id FROM team_users tu WHERE tu.team_id = t.id) AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date) AND i.id IN (SELECT bi.issue_id FROM board_issues bi JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.`table` = 'boards' AND pm.row_id = bi.board_id WHERE pm.project_name IN ($project))) AS `Issues resolved` FROM teams t WHERE t.name IN ($team) ORDER BY t.name

panels.title: Credits per week by team
panels.description: Kiro credits (official usage report) per person per week. One bar per team per week (members via team_users). Same slot and colour for a team in every band.

targets.rawSql: WITH RECURSIVE wk AS (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS w UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(w, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(w, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < DATE($__timeTo())), tm AS (SELECT t.id, t.name FROM teams t WHERE t.name IN ($team)) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(wk.w, '%m-%d') AS week, tm.name AS team, COALESCE(m.v, 0) AS credits FROM wk CROSS JOIN tm LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(r.date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(r.date) DAY) AS w, t.id AS gid, SUM(r.credits_used) AS v FROM _tool_kiro_user_report r JOIN user_accounts ua ON ua.account_id = r.user_email JOIN users u ON u.id = ua.user_id JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = u.id JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.date) GROUP BY 1, 2) m ON m.w = wk.w AND m.gid = tm.id ORDER BY wk.w, tm.name

panels.title: Session-linked commits per week by team
panels.description: Commits carrying a session trailer, per person per week. One bar per team per week (members via team_users). Same slot and colour for a team in every band.

targets.rawSql: WITH RECURSIVE wk AS (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS w UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(w, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(w, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < DATE($__timeTo())), tm AS (SELECT t.id, t.name FROM teams t WHERE t.name IN ($team)) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(wk.w, '%m-%d') AS week, tm.name AS team, COALESCE(m.v, 0) AS session_linked_commits FROM wk CROSS JOIN tm LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(c.authored_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(c.authored_date) DAY) AS w, t.id AS gid, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.commit_sha) AS v FROM _tool_kiro_session_commits sc JOIN commits c ON c.sha = sc.commit_sha JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha JOIN user_accounts ua ON ua.account_id = c.author_id JOIN users u ON u.id = ua.user_id JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = u.id JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.authored_date) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project)) GROUP BY 1, 2) m ON m.w = wk.w AND m.gid = tm.id ORDER BY wk.w, tm.name

panels.title: Merged PRs per week by team
panels.description: Merged pull requests per person per week. One bar per team per week (members via team_users). Same slot and colour for a team in every band.

targets.rawSql: WITH RECURSIVE wk AS (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS w UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(w, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(w, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < DATE($__timeTo())), tm AS (SELECT t.id, t.name FROM teams t WHERE t.name IN ($team)) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(wk.w, '%m-%d') AS week, tm.name AS team, COALESCE(m.v, 0) AS merged_prs FROM wk CROSS JOIN tm LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.merged_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.merged_date) DAY) AS w, t.id AS gid, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS v FROM pull_requests pr JOIN user_accounts ua ON ua.account_id = pr.author_id JOIN users u ON u.id = ua.user_id JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = u.id JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id WHERE pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project)) GROUP BY 1, 2) m ON m.w = wk.w AND m.gid = tm.id ORDER BY wk.w, tm.name

panels.title: Issues resolved per week by team
panels.description: Issues with a resolution date per person per week (assignee). One bar per team per week (members via team_users). Same slot and colour for a team in every band.

targets.rawSql: WITH RECURSIVE wk AS (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS w UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(w, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(w, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < DATE($__timeTo())), tm AS (SELECT t.id, t.name FROM teams t WHERE t.name IN ($team)) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(wk.w, '%m-%d') AS week, tm.name AS team, COALESCE(m.v, 0) AS resolved_issues FROM wk CROSS JOIN tm LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(i.resolution_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(i.resolution_date) DAY) AS w, t.id AS gid, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS v FROM issues i JOIN user_accounts ua ON ua.account_id = i.assignee_id JOIN users u ON u.id = ua.user_id JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = u.id JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id WHERE i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date) AND i.id IN (SELECT bi.issue_id FROM board_issues bi JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.`table` = 'boards' AND pm.row_id = bi.board_id WHERE pm.project_name IN ($project)) GROUP BY 1, 2) m ON m.w = wk.w AND m.gid = tm.id ORDER BY wk.w, tm.name

panels.title: Per person: credits → AI-linked commits → merged PRs → resolved issues (pick a team, then ≤ 8 people for the bars)
Per person totals (selected range)
panels.description: Totals for the selected people over the dashboard time range: credits (Kiro report), session-linked commits, merged PRs, resolved issues. Descriptive, as-is; no ratios on purpose.

targets.rawSql: SELECT u.name AS `Person`, t.name AS `Team`, (SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.credits_used), 0)) FROM _tool_kiro_user_report r JOIN user_accounts ua ON ua.account_id = r.user_email WHERE ua.user_id = u.id AND $__timeFilter(r.date)) AS `Credits`, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sc.commit_sha) FROM _tool_kiro_session_commits sc JOIN commits c ON c.sha = sc.commit_sha JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha JOIN user_accounts ua ON ua.account_id = c.author_id WHERE ua.user_id = u.id AND $__timeFilter(c.authored_date) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project))) AS `AI-linked commits`, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) FROM pull_requests pr JOIN user_accounts ua ON ua.account_id = pr.author_id WHERE ua.user_id = u.id AND pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project))) AS `Merged PRs`, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) FROM issues i JOIN user_accounts ua ON ua.account_id = i.assignee_id WHERE ua.user_id = u.id AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date) AND i.id IN (SELECT bi.issue_id FROM board_issues bi JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.`table` = 'boards' AND pm.row_id = bi.board_id WHERE pm.project_name IN ($project))) AS `Issues resolved` FROM users u JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = u.id JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id WHERE t.name IN ($team) AND u.name IN ($person) ORDER BY t.name, u.name

panels.title: Person × week matrix — $metric (scales to many people; rows keep their order when the metric changes)
panels.description: One row per selected person (grouped by team, then name), one column per week, cell colour = the metric chosen in the Metric selector. Zero-filled, so every person has every week. Colour is scaled within each week column (who was high that week); read the numbers to follow one person across weeks. Use this instead of the bars when more than ~8 people are selected.

targets.rawSql: WITH RECURSIVE wk AS (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS w UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(w, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(w, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < DATE($__timeTo())), ppl AS (SELECT u.id, u.name, t.name AS team FROM users u JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = u.id JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id WHERE t.name IN ($team) AND u.name IN ($person)) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(wk.w, '%m-%d') AS week, ppl.name AS person, CASE '$metric' WHEN 'credits' THEN COALESCE(m0.v, 0) WHEN 'session_linked_commits' THEN COALESCE(m1.v, 0) WHEN 'merged_prs' THEN COALESCE(m2.v, 0) ELSE COALESCE(m3.v, 0) END AS value FROM wk CROSS JOIN ppl LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(r.date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(r.date) DAY) AS w, u.id AS gid, SUM(r.credits_used) AS v FROM _tool_kiro_user_report r JOIN user_accounts ua ON ua.account_id = r.user_email JOIN users u ON u.id = ua.user_id JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = u.id JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.date) GROUP BY 1, 2) m0 ON m0.w = wk.w AND m0.gid = ppl.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(c.authored_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(c.authored_date) DAY) AS w, u.id AS gid, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.commit_sha) AS v FROM _tool_kiro_session_commits sc JOIN commits c ON c.sha = sc.commit_sha JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha JOIN user_accounts ua ON ua.account_id = c.author_id JOIN users u ON u.id = ua.user_id JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = u.id JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.authored_date) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project)) GROUP BY 1, 2) m1 ON m1.w = wk.w AND m1.gid = ppl.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.merged_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.merged_date) DAY) AS w, u.id AS gid, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS v FROM pull_requests pr JOIN user_accounts ua ON ua.account_id = pr.author_id JOIN users u ON u.id = ua.user_id JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = u.id JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id WHERE pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project)) GROUP BY 1, 2) m2 ON m2.w = wk.w AND m2.gid = ppl.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(i.resolution_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(i.resolution_date) DAY) AS w, u.id AS gid, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS v FROM issues i JOIN user_accounts ua ON ua.account_id = i.assignee_id JOIN users u ON u.id = ua.user_id JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = u.id JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id WHERE i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date) AND i.id IN (SELECT bi.issue_id FROM board_issues bi JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.`table` = 'boards' AND pm.row_id = bi.board_id WHERE pm.project_name IN ($project)) GROUP BY 1, 2) m3 ON m3.w = wk.w AND m3.gid = ppl.id ORDER BY ppl.team, ppl.name, wk.w

panels.title: Credits per week
panels.description: Kiro credits (official usage report) per person per week. Identity: user_email → user_accounts → users. Grouped bars: one slot per person inside every week, zero-filled, so the same person sits in the same slot and colour in every band.

targets.rawSql: WITH RECURSIVE wk AS (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS w UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(w, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(w, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < DATE($__timeTo())), ppl AS (SELECT u.id, u.name FROM users u JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = u.id JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id WHERE t.name IN ($team) AND u.name IN ($person)) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(wk.w, '%m-%d') AS week, ppl.name AS person, COALESCE(m.v, 0) AS credits FROM wk CROSS JOIN ppl LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(r.date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(r.date) DAY) AS w, u.id AS gid, SUM(r.credits_used) AS v FROM _tool_kiro_user_report r JOIN user_accounts ua ON ua.account_id = r.user_email JOIN users u ON u.id = ua.user_id JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = u.id JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.date) GROUP BY 1, 2) m ON m.w = wk.w AND m.gid = ppl.id ORDER BY wk.w, ppl.name

panels.title: Session-linked commits per week
panels.description: Commits carrying a session trailer, per person per week. Identity: commit author_id → user_accounts → users. The bridge between spend (above) and delivery (below). Grouped bars: one slot per person inside every week, zero-filled, so the same person sits in the same slot and colour in every band.

targets.rawSql: WITH RECURSIVE wk AS (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS w UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(w, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(w, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < DATE($__timeTo())), ppl AS (SELECT u.id, u.name FROM users u JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = u.id JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id WHERE t.name IN ($team) AND u.name IN ($person)) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(wk.w, '%m-%d') AS week, ppl.name AS person, COALESCE(m.v, 0) AS session_linked_commits FROM wk CROSS JOIN ppl LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(c.authored_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(c.authored_date) DAY) AS w, u.id AS gid, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.commit_sha) AS v FROM _tool_kiro_session_commits sc JOIN commits c ON c.sha = sc.commit_sha JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha JOIN user_accounts ua ON ua.account_id = c.author_id JOIN users u ON u.id = ua.user_id JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = u.id JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.authored_date) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project)) GROUP BY 1, 2) m ON m.w = wk.w AND m.gid = ppl.id ORDER BY wk.w, ppl.name

panels.title: Merged PRs per week
panels.description: Merged pull requests per person per week. Identity: PR author_id → user_accounts → users. Grouped bars: one slot per person inside every week, zero-filled, so the same person sits in the same slot and colour in every band.

targets.rawSql: WITH RECURSIVE wk AS (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS w UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(w, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(w, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < DATE($__timeTo())), ppl AS (SELECT u.id, u.name FROM users u JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = u.id JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id WHERE t.name IN ($team) AND u.name IN ($person)) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(wk.w, '%m-%d') AS week, ppl.name AS person, COALESCE(m.v, 0) AS merged_prs FROM wk CROSS JOIN ppl LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.merged_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.merged_date) DAY) AS w, u.id AS gid, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS v FROM pull_requests pr JOIN user_accounts ua ON ua.account_id = pr.author_id JOIN users u ON u.id = ua.user_id JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = u.id JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id WHERE pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project)) GROUP BY 1, 2) m ON m.w = wk.w AND m.gid = ppl.id ORDER BY wk.w, ppl.name

panels.title: Issues resolved per week
panels.description: Issues with a resolution date per person per week (assignee). Identity: assignee_id → user_accounts → users. Grouped bars: one slot per person inside every week, zero-filled, so the same person sits in the same slot and colour in every band.

targets.rawSql: WITH RECURSIVE wk AS (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS w UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(w, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(w, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < DATE($__timeTo())), ppl AS (SELECT u.id, u.name FROM users u JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = u.id JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id WHERE t.name IN ($team) AND u.name IN ($person)) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(wk.w, '%m-%d') AS week, ppl.name AS person, COALESCE(m.v, 0) AS resolved_issues FROM wk CROSS JOIN ppl LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(i.resolution_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(i.resolution_date) DAY) AS w, u.id AS gid, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS v FROM issues i JOIN user_accounts ua ON ua.account_id = i.assignee_id JOIN users u ON u.id = ua.user_id JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = u.id JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id WHERE i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date) AND i.id IN (SELECT bi.issue_id FROM board_issues bi JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.`table` = 'boards' AND pm.row_id = bi.board_id WHERE pm.project_name IN ($project)) GROUP BY 1, 2) m ON m.w = wk.w AND m.gid = ppl.id ORDER BY wk.w, ppl.name

panels.title: Credits per week (total)
panels.description: From _tool_kiro_user_report (official billing). Not project-filtered: credits have no repo dimension.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(r.date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(r.date) DAY) AS time, SUM(r.credits_used) AS credits FROM _tool_kiro_user_report r WHERE $__timeFilter(r.date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Issues resolved per week (total)
panels.description: All resolved issues by resolution_date. Not project-filtered by repo; issue boards may span projects.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(i.resolution_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(i.resolution_date) DAY) AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS resolved_issues FROM issues i WHERE i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date) AND i.id IN (SELECT bi.issue_id FROM board_issues bi JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.`table` = 'boards' AND pm.row_id = bi.board_id WHERE pm.project_name IN ($project)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: By raw identity (unmapped namespaces: Kiro users · PR authors · issue assignees · git emails)
Credits per week by person (Kiro users)
panels.description: One series per Kiro user (display name, falling back to user id). Namespace: Kiro identity.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(r.date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(r.date) DAY) AS time, COALESCE(MAX(r.display_name), r.user_id) AS metric, SUM(r.credits_used) AS credits FROM _tool_kiro_user_report r WHERE $__timeFilter(r.date) GROUP BY 1, r.user_id ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Merged PRs per week by PR author
panels.description: One series per PR author (code-host login, as collected by the forge plugin). Namespace: code-host identity. Same week buckets as the credits and issue panels, so a person can be read across all three.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.merged_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.merged_date) DAY) AS time, CASE WHEN pr.author_name = '' OR pr.author_name IS NULL THEN 'unknown' ELSE pr.author_name END AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS merged_prs FROM pull_requests pr WHERE pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project)) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Issues resolved per week by assignee
panels.description: One series per issue assignee. Namespace: issue tracker identity — not merged with Kiro users.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(i.resolution_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(i.resolution_date) DAY) AS time, CASE WHEN i.assignee_name = '' OR i.assignee_name IS NULL THEN 'unassigned' ELSE i.assignee_name END AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS resolved_issues FROM issues i WHERE i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date) AND i.id IN (SELECT bi.issue_id FROM board_issues bi JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.`table` = 'boards' AND pm.row_id = bi.board_id WHERE pm.project_name IN ($project)) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Session-linked commits per week by author
panels.description: One series per git author email; counts commits carrying a session trailer. Namespace: git identity.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(c.authored_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(c.authored_date) DAY) AS time, CASE WHEN c.author_email = '' OR c.author_email IS NULL THEN 'unknown' ELSE c.author_email END AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.commit_sha) AS session_linked_commits FROM _tool_kiro_session_commits sc JOIN commits c ON c.sha = sc.commit_sha JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha WHERE $__timeFilter(c.authored_date) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project)) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Commits: all vs session-linked (weekly)
panels.description: Gap between the bars = commits without a trailer (human-only work, or hooks not installed)

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(c.authored_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(c.authored_date) DAY) AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT c.sha) AS all_commits, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.commit_sha) AS session_linked FROM commits c JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha LEFT JOIN _tool_kiro_session_commits sc ON sc.commit_sha = c.sha WHERE $__timeFilter(c.authored_date) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Merged PRs: all vs session-linked (weekly)
panels.description: A PR counts as session-linked when any of its commits carries a trailer

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.merged_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.merged_date) DAY) AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS merged_prs, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sc.session_id IS NOT NULL THEN pr.id END) AS session_linked_prs FROM pull_requests pr JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.pull_request_id = pr.id JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = prc.commit_sha LEFT JOIN _tool_kiro_session_commits sc ON sc.commit_sha = prc.commit_sha WHERE pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Session → Commit → PR → Issue (latest 200)
panels.description: Empty PR/Issue cells mean that hop has no edge yet: PR not merged/collected, or no issue key referenced

targets.rawSql: SELECT sc.session_id AS `Session`, sc.trailer_key AS `Agent`, SUBSTRING(sc.commit_sha, 1, 8) AS `Commit`, c.authored_date AS `Authored`, pr.pull_request_key AS `PR #`, pr.title AS `PR Title`, pr.merged_date AS `Merged`, pri.issue_key AS `Issue`, i.title AS `Issue Title`, i.type AS `Issue Type`, i.assignee_name AS `Assignee` FROM _tool_kiro_session_commits sc JOIN commits c ON c.sha = sc.commit_sha JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha LEFT JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha LEFT JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id LEFT JOIN pull_request_issues pri ON pri.pull_request_id = pr.id LEFT JOIN issues i ON i.id = pri.issue_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.authored_date) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project)) ORDER BY c.authored_date DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Issues by AI involvement (dose, as-is)
panels.description: Sessions/commits/PRs per issue. Dose comparison is only meaningful within similar task types.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pri.issue_key AS `Issue`, MAX(i.title) AS `Title`, MAX(i.type) AS `Type`, MAX(CASE WHEN i.assignee_name = '' OR i.assignee_name IS NULL THEN 'unassigned' ELSE i.assignee_name END) AS `Assignee`, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.session_id) AS `Sessions`, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.commit_sha) AS `Commits`, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS `PRs` FROM _tool_kiro_session_commits sc JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id JOIN pull_request_issues pri ON pri.pull_request_id = pr.id JOIN issues i ON i.id = pri.issue_id JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha WHERE pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project)) GROUP BY pri.issue_key ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT sc.session_id) DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Assignees by AI-linked delivery
panels.description: Per-assignee rollup of AI-linked issues/PRs/sessions. Descriptive only — NOT a ranking; task mix differs per person.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN i.assignee_name = '' OR i.assignee_name IS NULL THEN 'unassigned' ELSE i.assignee_name END AS `Assignee`, COUNT(DISTINCT pri.issue_id) AS `AI-linked issues`, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS `PRs`, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.session_id) AS `Sessions`, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.commit_sha) AS `Commits` FROM _tool_kiro_session_commits sc JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id JOIN pull_request_issues pri ON pri.pull_request_id = pr.id JOIN issues i ON i.id = pri.issue_id JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha WHERE pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT pri.issue_id) DESC LIMIT 50
